第5章邪虎为幡御百鬼
“我习练法器，动静颇大，在这县城左近若是被人瞧见了，怕是会有麻烦。昨天去的那座祖荫山距离不远，又少有人迹，倒是一个合适的去处。顺便还能拜访一番那老狐一家，问一问这左近的地理情况，有什么修行宗派，又有那些道行之士常来常往。”
“被收藏于楼观道数百万载，我对这个世界还真是两眼一抹黑，不如结交一二好友，在此世也有一个根基。”
“当然，这须得等到我结束第一次任务之后，再找机会。”
钱晨谋定后动，一担打定主意就立刻动身，他走出这间荒僻小院，直奔东南方向的祖荫山去。
临走前，钱晨察觉到昨日那布庄的伙计正躲在暗处悄悄窥视，他也不理会，身子一纵就消失在原地，那小伙计只能看到一道黑影，如疾驰骏马闪过，当即吓得呆在了原地，良久才回过神来，颤声道：“果真是异人，得快些回去禀告掌柜。”
今日比昨日更快，只用了小半个时辰，钱晨就熟门熟路的摸到了祖荫后山。
他也不去见那老狐一家，钱晨办事从来以正事为先，无论中间有多少插曲，只要是能放下的，他都会先完成初衷，再去考虑其他。今日既是来熟悉法器，老狐就算家里有几个千娇百媚的女儿，个个都愿意自荐枕席，也与正事无关。
钱晨先是祭起龙雀环，只见他右臂手腕上的玉环滴溜溜的转动，变成脸盆大小，从钱晨手中脱落下来，由着他往下一指，便化为一个五彩光环落下，只是一套，便将一棵高达数丈的大树连根拔起，消失不见。
原地留下一个深达数丈的大坑。
微微平复气息，钱晨调息了一刻才恢复了过来，暗道：“以内力驱动法器，还是有些艰难。法器这种东西，就不是筑基时该玩的。筑基期理应平和顺气，老老实实勤勤恳恳的度过去，待到感应天地元气，内气外气相合，炼成一口真气后，才能出来浪。”
“但轮回之地，怕是不会给我这个时间。”
“这龙雀环真力很大，生生拔起一棵丈十高的大树，这是何等神力。怕是有一挖掘机之力……唉！这样一想，好像也不过如此了！”
钱晨只是开玩笑的想一想而已，就是普通的挖掘机，也有近二百马力。那就是二百匹马合力所拉动的巨力。前世有多少大力士，能挽得住一匹发疯的健马的？而且龙雀环收拿只在瞬间，爆发力极强，一瞬间爆发出两百匹马来拉人，没几个人能抵得住。”
钱晨再把龙雀环放大缩小，或是隐蔽成一个不起眼的小环，操纵着突然偷袭；或是倾尽全力，大张旗鼓的收拿山石。
最后测试出了龙雀环的收拿真力与环圈大小有关，若是缩到最小，只有食指戒指的大小，那最多也就能收一收脑袋大小的石头，莫约也就是一个成年人的力气。若是威力全开，胀大到水缸大小，却能勉强拔起一块半身沉在土中，约有二十八吨重的石头。
这一次测试差点把钱晨累的闭过气去，他调息了好久才将呼吸转为正常的内息。
龙雀环缩小成镯子大小，悬浮在钱晨的手上。
“这般大小最适合偷袭，我将灵光压到最隐蔽，暗中放出龙雀环绕到某人脑后，大约就能把他头颅套走。修行之士的身体强度，也就比平常人结实一些，还未有习武的横练之士身体坚韧，这般偷袭之下，绝对能无声无息把人头颅摘去。”
“谁说龙雀环只能收拿，在我手中不就跟血滴子差不多吗？”钱晨打趣道。

当然他也知道，这只是一句玩笑话罢了。通法境界的修士就能练成许多护身法术，龙雀环不破去法术，休想沾到人家的身子。而那些有护身法器的，祭起法器护着自己滴水不漏，比如钱晨头上若是悬着天罗伞，不用龙雀环把伞收走，如何近得了身子。
而乌金黑煞钩这等飞剑，却能以剑术在一瞬间破开护身宝光，在瞬息之间将敌人的性命取去。
一个是死力去拿，另外一个却是抽冷子扎一下，哪个杀伤力更大不问自知。
龙雀环这样偷袭，也只有欺负通法境界以下，或是穷苦的连护身法器都没有的散修。
钱晨又诸般测试了一翻龙雀环的其他方面，他伸手掷出玉环，在先前被他拔起来的巨石上，砸下了脑袋大小的一块，然后叹息收起，果然不是杀伐之宝。又拿出七煞幡来，钱晨舞动黑幡，瞬间飞沙走石，煞气滚滚，一股黑气如巨蟒一般自幡上腾起，在那巨石上绕了三圈。
只听见哗哗沙沙的声音不断响起，待钱晨收起七煞幡后，露出那块巨石，已然整整小了一半，周围都是散落的石粉，细如尘埃一般。
钱晨气息，还比先前运用龙雀环更加稳定。
“这才是杀伐之宝啊！”钱晨略有些叹息，不算那白骨舍利，这件法器应当是他手中威力最大的了。当然也已经几乎没有提升的空间！
钱晨到了通法境界后，一个照面便能用龙雀环收拿这面黑煞幡。

Chapter 5 The evil tiger serves as a banner to fight against hundreds of ghosts
"I practice magic weapons, and there is a lot of noise. If I am seen near this county, I am afraid there will be trouble. The Zuyin Mountain I went to yesterday is not far away, and there are few people there, so it is a suitable place to go. By the way, I can also visit the old fox family and ask about the geographical conditions nearby, what spiritual sects are there, and those Taoist practitioners who often come and go."
"Having been kept in Louguan Dao for millions of years, I really have a dark eye on this world. It's better to make one or two friends and have a foundation in this world."
"Of course, I have to wait until I finish my first mission before looking for an opportunity."
Qian Chen made up his mind before moving on. Once he made up his mind, he set off immediately. He walked out of this remote courtyard and headed straight to Zuyin Mountain in the southeast.
Before leaving, Qian Chen noticed that the boy from yesterday's cloth store was hiding in the dark and peeking quietly. He ignored it and disappeared in place. The boy could only see a black shadow, like a galloping horse flashing by. He was so frightened that he froze in place. It took him a long time to come back to his senses and said in a trembling voice: "It's really a strange person. I have to go back and report it to the shopkeeper."
Today was faster than yesterday. It only took less than half an hour for Qian Chen to reach Zuyin Back Mountain by a familiar route.
He didn't go to see the old fox family either. Qian Chen always put business first when doing things. No matter how many interruptions there were, as long as he could let it go, he would complete his original intention first and then think about other things. Since I am here to get familiar with the magic weapon today, even if the old fox has several charming daughters at home, all of them are willing to recommend themselves to the pillow mat, it has nothing to do with business.
Qian Chen first offered the dragon bird ring, and saw the jade ring on his right wrist turning slowly, becoming the size of a washbasin, and falling off Qian Chen's hand. When he pointed down, it turned into a colorful halo and fell. With just one set, a large tree several feet high was uprooted and disappeared.
A large crater several feet deep was left on the spot.
After calming down slightly, Qian Chen adjusted his breath for a moment before recovering, and said to himself: "It is still a bit difficult to drive a magical weapon with internal force. Magical weapons are not something you should play with during foundation building. The foundation building period should be peaceful and smooth, and you should spend it honestly and diligently. Only after you sense the vitality of the world and the internal and external energy, and refine it into a breath of true energy, can you come out."
"But the land of reincarnation may not give me this time."
"This dragon bird ring is really powerful. It can uproot a tree ten feet high. What a magical power it is. I'm afraid it has the power of an excavator... Sigh! Thinking about it this way, it seems like it's nothing more than that!"
Qian Chen just thought about it jokingly. Even an ordinary excavator has nearly 200 horsepower. That is the huge force pulled by the combined force of two hundred horses. How many strong men in previous lives could hold back a crazy horse? Moreover, the Dragon Bird Ring can only be closed in an instant, and its explosive power is extremely strong. In an instant, two hundred horses burst out to pull people, and few people can withstand it. "
Qian Chen then enlarged or reduced the dragon bird ring, or concealed it into an inconspicuous small ring, and controlled a sudden sneak attack; or he used all his strength to collect the rocks with great fanfare.
The final test showed that the holding power of the dragon bird ring is related to the size of the ring. If it is shrunk to the minimum, only the size of an index finger ring, it can hold a stone as big as a head at most, which is about the strength of an adult. If it is fully powered and expanded to the size of a water tank, it can barely pull up a stone that is half-sunken in the soil and weighs about 28 tons.
This test almost made Qian Chen breathless from exhaustion. He adjusted his breathing for a long time before returning to normal breathing.
The dragon bird ring shrank to the size of a bracelet and floated on Qian Chen's hand.
"This size is most suitable for sneak attacks. I suppress the spiritual light to the most concealed level, secretly release the dragon bird to surround someone's head, and I can probably pull his head away. The physical strength of cultivators is stronger than that of ordinary people. There is no physical strength of martial arts practitioners who can sneak attack like this.Under this, it is absolutely possible to remove a person's head silently. "
"Who said that the dragon bird ring can only be held in storage? Isn't it just like a blood drop in my hand? Qian Chen joked.
Of course he also knew that this was just a joke. Monks in the Dharma realm can practice many self-protection spells. If the dragon bird ring does not break the spell, there is no way it can touch someone else's body. And those who have magical weapons to protect themselves use them to protect themselves without leakage. For example, if Qian Chen has a Tianluo umbrella hanging on his head, he doesn't need a dragon bird ring to take the umbrella away, so he can't get close to him.
However, flying swords such as the Wujin Black Hook can break through the protective light in an instant with swordsmanship, and take away the enemy's life in an instant.
One is trying his best to get it, while the other is trying to prick it. I don’t know which one is more lethal.
Dragon Bird Ring's sneak attack like this can only bully casual cultivators who are below the realm of Tongfa or who are poor and don't even have protective magic weapons.
Qian Chen tested other aspects of the dragon bird ring in various ways. He stretched out his hand and threw the jade ring, and smashed a head-sized piece on the boulder he had pulled up before. Then he sighed and put it away. It was indeed not a killing treasure. He also took out the Seven Evil Flags, and Qian Chen waved the black flags, causing sand and rocks to fly instantly, and evil spirits rolling in. A stream of black energy rose up from the flags like a giant python, and circled around the boulder three times.
Only the sound of rustling was heard. After Qian Chen put away the Qisha banner, the huge stone was revealed, which was half smaller. It was surrounded by scattered stone powder, as fine as dust.
Qian Chen's aura was more stable than when he used the Dragon Bird Ring before.
“This is the treasure of killing! "Qian Chen sighed slightly. Not counting the bone relic, this magical weapon should be the most powerful in his hand. Of course, there is almost no room for improvement!
After Qian Chen reached the realm of Tongfa, he could use the dragon bird ring to collect the black evil flag in one glance.
